A copper-alloy nummus of Valens, AD364-378. Mint is Arles, AD364-375, Reece period is 19. Obverse shows pearl-diademed bust right. Obverse legend reads [...]VALEN-[...]. Reverse shows Victory advancing left, holding wreath and palm. Reverse legend reads [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE]. Reverse fields and exergue reads -III//[...].
